form.label: editacl - run monitor
form.description: Which editacl runs took place, and how the selected one went. Neither an empty view nor a populated one proves that the list below is complete: read the entitlement check first, including the date of the most recent journal line.

search.query: `acl_journal_source` | stats count AS journal_events, max(_time) AS last_journal_event, values(index) AS journal_read_from | appendcols [| eventcount summarize=false index=* index=_* | stats count AS searchable_index_count, values(index) AS searchable_indexes] | appendcols [| tstats count AS ingested_events, max(_time) AS last_ingested WHERE (index=* OR index=_*) sourcetype=editacl:journal BY index | stats sum(ingested_events) AS ingested_events, values(index) AS journal_found_in] | addinfo | eval searchable_index_count = coalesce(searchable_index_count, 0) | eval ingested_events = coalesce(ingested_events, 0) | eval unread_events = ingested_events - journal_events | eval read_index_count = coalesce(mvcount(journal_read_from), 0) | eval found_index_count = coalesce(mvcount(journal_found_in), 0) | eval window_end = if(isnum(info_max_time), info_max_time, now()) | eval window_s = if(isnum(info_min_time), window_end - info_min_time, null()) | eval silent_tail_s = if(isnull(last_journal_event), null(), round(window_end - last_journal_event, 0)) | eval silent_tail_pct = if(isnull(silent_tail_s) OR isnull(window_s) OR window_s <= 0, null(), round(100 * silent_tail_s / window_s, 1)) | eval state = case( searchable_index_count == 0, "NO SEARCHABLE INDEX - your role has no index entitlement. Granting it is a deployment prerequisite, outside this app. An empty view does NOT mean that no run took place.", unread_events > 0 OR found_index_count > read_index_count, "JOURNAL LINES SIT OUTSIDE WHAT THIS VIEW READS - compare the two index columns opposite. Redirecting local/inputs.conf without overriding local/macros.conf produces exactly this, and the panels below then stop at the date of the redirection without saying so. During a deliberate migration the same reading is expected until the old index ages out.", journal_events == 0, "NO EVENT IN THIS WINDOW - either no run was recorded, or the journal does not land in an index you may search. Check that the index listed opposite is the one inputs.conf sends the journal to.", silent_tail_pct > 25, "READABLE, BUT THE END OF THIS WINDOW IS SILENT - the last " . silent_tail_pct . "% of it carries no journal line, past a threshold of 25% that is A CHOSEN VALUE AND NOT A MEASURED ONE. Either no run took place since then, or the journal stopped reaching this index. THIS PANEL CANNOT TELL THOSE TWO APART - it reports the silence, it does not diagnose it.", 1==1, "OK on both signals above - the journal is readable here, and its most recent line falls inside the last 25% of the window. THAT 25% IS A CHOSEN VALUE, NOT A MEASURED ONE: on the shipped default range, which is seven days plus the hours already elapsed today, it takes between 42 and 48 hours of silence to leave this state, and a reader entitled only to the index the journal used to land in gets no other warning in the meantime. Judge the date at the start of this line against how often runs are expected here - this word cannot do it for you.") | eval last_journal_event = if(isnull(last_journal_event), "(none in this window)", strftime(last_journal_event, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) | eval journal_age = if(isnull(silent_tail_s), "(no journal line in this window)", tostring(silent_tail_s, "duration")) | eval state = "LAST JOURNAL LINE READ: " . last_journal_event . ", age at the end of the window " . journal_age . ". -- " . state | table state, last_journal_event, journal_age, silent_tail_pct, journal_events, journal_read_from, journal_found_in, unread_events, searchable_index_count, searchable_indexes

panel.title: Runs started with no journal line

html.p: A run appears here when the diagnostic file carries lines for it and the journal carries none. What the four causes mean:

ul.li: journal_disabled - the run was launched with journal=false, so no journal file was produced, by design. Nothing about the objects of this run is recoverable.
journal_not_openable - the rollback journal could not be opened. A WARNING line of this run names a journal file.
fatal_error - the run stopped before its first journal line and carries a CRITICAL diagnostic line.

no_write_recorded - no journal line and no CRITICAL line either. The run may have been killed before its first write. This is the code that says nothing was established, not the one that names a cause.

html.p: The last two columns are the evidence the code is derived from: the number of CRITICAL lines, and the number of WARNING lines naming a journal file. A cause the reader cannot check is a verdict.

search.query: | multisearch [search `acl_journal_source`] [search `acl_diag_source`] | eval diag_raw = if(sourcetype="editacl:diag", _raw, null()) | rex field=diag_raw "^\S+\s+(?<diag_level>[A-Z]+)\s+sid=(?<diag_sid>\S+)" | rex field=diag_raw "\bversion=\S+\s+user=(?<diag_user>\S+)\s" | rex field=diag_raw "\bdryrun=\S+\s+validate_roles=\S+\s+journal=(?<diag_journal>\S+)\s" | rex field=diag_raw "(?<diag_journal_file>editacl_journal\S*\.log)" | eval sid = coalesce(diag_sid, sid) | stats count(eval(sourcetype="editacl:journal")) AS journal_lines, count(eval(sourcetype="editacl:diag")) AS diag_lines, min(eval(if(sourcetype="editacl:diag", _time, null()))) AS started, values(diag_user) AS run_user, values(diag_journal) AS journal_param, count(eval(diag_level="CRITICAL")) AS fatal_lines, count(eval(diag_level="WARNING" AND isnotnull(diag_journal_file))) AS journal_open_failures BY sid | where journal_lines = 0 AND diag_lines > 0 | eval cause = case( journal_param="false", "journal_disabled", journal_open_failures > 0, "journal_not_openable", fatal_lines > 0, "fatal_error", 1==1, "no_write_recorded") | sort - started | convert ctime(started) | table started, sid, run_user, cause, fatal_lines, journal_open_failures

`acl_journal_source` | stats min(_time) AS first_line, max(_time) AS last_line, values(user) AS run_user, values(host) AS member, values(dryrun) AS dryrun_values, count AS journal_lines, count(eval(phase="outcome")) AS output_events, count(eval(phase="intent")) AS writes_attempted, count(eval(phase="summary")) AS end_of_run_lines, count(eval(phase="outcome" AND status="updated")) AS updated, count(eval(phase="outcome" AND status="noop")) AS noop, count(eval(phase="outcome" AND status="dryrun")) AS simulated, count(eval(phase="outcome" AND status="error")) AS errors, count(eval(phase="outcome" AND like(status,"skipped_%"))) AS skipped, dc(eval(if(phase="outcome", app, null()))) AS apps BY sid | eval other = output_events - (updated + noop + simulated + errors + skipped) | eval mode = case(mvcount(dryrun_values) > 1, "MIXED - inconsistent run", dryrun_values="true", "simulation", dryrun_values="false", "real", 1==1, "unknown") | eval run_state = case(end_of_run_lines > 1, "ANOMALY - several end-of-run lines", end_of_run_lines = 1, "completed", 1==1, "INTERRUPTED - no end-of-run line") | eval run_start = if(mvcount(split(sid,".")) = 2, tonumber(mvindex(split(sid,"."),0)), null()) | eval inventory_wait_s = if(isnull(run_start), null(), round(first_line - run_start, 3)) | eval write_span_s = round(last_line - first_line, 3) | eval started = coalesce(run_start, first_line) | sort - started | convert ctime(started) | table started, sid, run_user, member, mode, run_state, output_events, updated, noop, simulated, skipped, errors, other, apps, writes_attempted, inventory_wait_s, write_span_s, journal_lines

html.p: Select a run in the table above, or type its sid, to inspect it.

search.query: `acl_journal_source` sid="$sid$" | stats count AS journal_lines, min(_time) AS first_line, max(_time) AS last_line, values(user) AS run_user, values(host) AS member, values(dryrun) AS dryrun_values, count(eval(phase="outcome")) AS output_events, count(eval(phase="intent")) AS writes_attempted, count(eval(phase="summary")) AS end_of_run_lines, dc(eval(if(phase="outcome", app, null()))) AS apps BY sid | eval mode = case(mvcount(dryrun_values) > 1, "MIXED - inconsistent run", dryrun_values="true", "simulation", dryrun_values="false", "real", 1==1, "unknown") | eval run_state = case(end_of_run_lines > 1, "ANOMALY - several end-of-run lines", end_of_run_lines = 1, "completed", 1==1, "INTERRUPTED - no end-of-run line") | eval run_start = if(mvcount(split(sid,".")) = 2, tonumber(mvindex(split(sid,"."),0)), null()) | eval inventory_wait_s = if(isnull(run_start), null(), round(first_line - run_start, 3)) | eval write_span_s = round(last_line - first_line, 3) | eval started = coalesce(run_start, first_line) | convert ctime(started) | table sid, started, run_user, member, mode, run_state, output_events, writes_attempted, apps, inventory_wait_s, write_span_s, journal_lines

`acl_journal_source` sid="$sid$" phase=outcome | stats count AS observed BY status | append [search `acl_journal_source` sid="$sid$" phase=summary | fields count_* | transpose 0 column_name="counter" | rename "row 1" AS declared | where substr(counter, 1, 6) = "count_" | eval status = replace(counter, "^count_", "") | fields status, declared] | stats sum(observed) AS observed, sum(declared) AS declared BY status | eval observed = coalesce(observed, 0), declared = coalesce(declared, 0) | eventstats sum(declared) AS declared_total | where observed > 0 OR declared > 0 | eval consistency = case(declared_total = 0, "n/a - no end-of-run line", observed = declared, "=", 1==1, "MISMATCH - lines are missing from the journal") | sort - observed, status | table status, observed, declared, consistency

`acl_journal_source` sid="$sid$" phase=outcome | eval http_result = if(http_code="0", "0 - no HTTP exchange took place", http_code) | stats count AS events, values(status) AS statuses BY http_result | sort http_result

panel.title: Breakdown by application and object type

search.query: `acl_journal_source` sid="$sid$" phase=outcome | eval application = if(coalesce(app,"")="", "(not journaled)", app) | eval object_type = case(coalesce(handler,"")!="", handler, coalesce(eai_type,"")!="", eai_type, 1==1, "(not journaled)") | stats count AS events, values(status) AS statuses BY application, object_type | sort - events, application, object_type

html.p: One row per transition that actually happened, one column per object type. An attribute that did not move produces no row. The column is the handler path the command resolved - saved/searches, data/ui/views - which is filled in on every resolved object, unlike eai:type, which a batch read from the native endpoints does not carry at all. Lines that carry a type but no handler, written before the handler was journaled, are grouped under their type. (type not journaled) is left for the lines that carry neither, which means the object was refused before its endpoint could be resolved.

objects_changed counts result lines, not objects reconstructed from their fields: an object handed to the command twice counts twice. applied is the part the platform accepted, simulated the part a dryrun run would have written. In simulation nothing was written: the "after" value is the one that would be applied. Anything left over - objects_changed - applied - simulated - was attempted and refused; the Errors panel below says why.

search.query: `acl_journal_source` sid="$sid$" | where coalesce(endpoint,"") != "" | stats count(eval(phase="outcome")) AS result_lines, count(eval(phase="outcome" AND status="updated")) AS applied, count(eval(phase="outcome" AND status="dryrun")) AS simulated, values(handler) AS object_handler, values(eai_type) AS object_type, earliest(before_owner) AS before_owner, earliest(after_owner) AS after_owner, earliest(before_perms_read) AS before_read, earliest(after_perms_read) AS after_read, earliest(before_perms_write) AS before_write, earliest(after_perms_write) AS after_write, earliest(before_sharing) AS before_sharing, earliest(after_sharing) AS after_sharing BY endpoint | eval object_type = case(coalesce(object_handler,"")!="", object_handler, coalesce(object_type,"")!="", object_type, 1==1, "(type not journaled)") | eval change_type = mvappend( if(isnull(before_read) OR isnull(after_read) OR before_read = after_read, null(), "Read"), if(isnull(before_write) OR isnull(after_write) OR before_write = after_write, null(), "Write"), if(isnull(before_sharing) OR isnull(after_sharing) OR before_sharing = after_sharing, null(), "Sharing"), if(isnull(before_owner) OR isnull(after_owner) OR before_owner = after_owner, null(), "Owner")) | where isnotnull(change_type) | mvexpand change_type | eval before = case(change_type="Read", before_read, change_type="Write", before_write, change_type="Sharing", before_sharing, change_type="Owner", before_owner) | eval after = case(change_type="Read", after_read, change_type="Write", after_write, change_type="Sharing", after_sharing, change_type="Owner", after_owner) | eval before = if(before="", "(empty)", before) | eval after = if(after="", "(empty)", after) | stats sum(result_lines) AS objects_changed, sum(applied) AS applied, sum(simulated) AS simulated BY change_type, before, after, object_type | eval {object_type} = objects_changed | fields - object_type | stats sum(*) AS * BY change_type, before, after | sort - objects_changed, change_type, before, after | table change_type, before, after, objects_changed, applied, simulated, *

`acl_journal_source` sid="$sid$" | where coalesce(endpoint,"") != "" | stats values(eval(if(phase="outcome", status, null()))) AS status, values(eval(if(phase="outcome", http_code, null()))) AS http_code, values(eval(if(phase="outcome" AND error!="", error, null()))) AS error, values(app) AS application, values(title) AS title, values(handler) AS object_handler, values(eai_type) AS object_type, earliest(before_owner) AS before_owner, earliest(after_owner) AS after_owner, earliest(before_perms_read) AS before_read, earliest(after_perms_read) AS after_read, earliest(before_perms_write) AS before_write, earliest(after_perms_write) AS after_write, earliest(before_sharing) AS before_sharing, earliest(after_sharing) AS after_sharing, min(_time) AS first_seen BY endpoint | eval object_type = case(coalesce(object_handler,"")!="", object_handler, coalesce(object_type,"")!="", object_type, 1==1, "(not journaled)") | eval read_change = case(isnull(before_read) OR isnull(after_read), "n/a", before_read = after_read, "=", 1==1, "CHANGED") | eval write_change = case(isnull(before_write) OR isnull(after_write), "n/a", before_write = after_write, "=", 1==1, "CHANGED") | eval owner_change = case(isnull(before_owner) OR isnull(after_owner), "n/a", before_owner = after_owner, "=", 1==1, "CHANGED") | eval sharing_change = case(isnull(before_sharing) OR isnull(after_sharing), "n/a", before_sharing = after_sharing, "=", 1==1, "CHANGED") | sort first_seen | convert ctime(first_seen) | table first_seen, application, object_type, title, status, http_code, read_change, before_read, after_read, write_change, before_write, after_write, owner_change, before_owner, after_owner, sharing_change, before_sharing, after_sharing, error, endpoint

`acl_journal_source` sid="$sid$" phase=outcome | where coalesce(endpoint,"") = "" | eval application = if(coalesce(app,"")="", "(not journaled)", app) | eval object_type = case(coalesce(handler,"")!="", handler, coalesce(eai_type,"")!="", eai_type, 1==1, "(not journaled)") | eval error = if(error="", "(none)", error) | sort _time | table _time, application, object_type, title, status, http_code, error

`acl_journal_source` sid="$sid$" phase=outcome | search NOT status IN (updated, noop, dryrun) | rex field=error "^(?<error_class>[a-z_]+(?::\d+)?)" | eval error_class = coalesce(error_class, "(no message)") | eval object_type = case(coalesce(handler,"")!="", handler, coalesce(eai_type,"")!="", eai_type, 1==1, "(not journaled)") | stats count AS events, values(status) AS statuses, values(title) AS titles, values(error) AS messages BY error_class, object_type | sort - events

ul.li: Objects filtered out upstream of editacl by the calling search never reached the command and appear nowhere: neither a candidate volume nor a selection rate.
acl_warning is not journaled: the output warnings, including the cascade warning on a derived object and the write-ceiling warning, cannot be recovered after the fact.
The calling search is not in the journal. It is in the platform audit index, out of reach of the read role of this view.
The direction of a batch - outbound change or rollback - is not journaled: both look like writes.
An empty view does not prove that no run took place. Read the entitlement check panel first.

The journal format is not versioned, and this view assumes it is homogeneous: every line in the window is read as the format the shipped command writes. Lines written by an older format are read as if they were current, and no panel can tell you so. Should the format ever change, the transition is a deployment question - see the README.

A transition listed in the ACL change breakdown is what the command computed. In simulation nothing was written at all, and on a failed write the "after" value is the one that was refused. The applied and simulated columns of that panel are what separate the three cases.
